label: DEMO SNAPSHOT — sample Commons picture of the day pictures, not live
note: Bundled demo data. Served only when the live feed fails or has no stills. Every image is on this source's own host.

items.title: Wikimedia Commons picture of the day for September 20
items.summary: Picture of the day Inflorescence of a Rostrinucula dependens . This subshrub is native to China and blooms from August to October. Focus stack of 54 photos.

items.title: Wikimedia Commons picture of the day for September 21
items.summary: Picture of the day Chief Joseph of the Wallowa band of Nez Perce , an American Native American tribe in the Pacific Northwest . This photo was taken by Edward Sheriff Curtis . Chief Joseph died on this day in 1904.

items.title: Wikimedia Commons picture of the day for September 22
items.summary: Picture of the day Beach of Cape Fiolent during the storm at sea. Cape Fiolent in Crimea is of ancient Jurassic origin. Upper Miocene lava and carbonate intrusions on heavily eroded Jurassic foundation.
